expectations.evidence: Source trait, Processor trait, Destination trait — three independent extension points. Each with multiple impls.
Vec<Box<dyn Processor>> applied sequentially. Each processor independently testable.
Each source/processor/destination is its own struct with own config. Adding Kafka sink doesn't touch file sink.
Pipeline.run() is a small orchestrator: read from source, process through chain, ship to all destinations. Clean separation.
